subject.title: fix(agents): terminate mixed tool-call batches on critical loop veto

question: Should a critical tool-loop veto end through agent-core's graceful post-turn stop, or be surfaced as an explicit embedded run-owner abort?
rationale: Both open PRs stop further provider turns, but they differ in terminal-state classification and steering/follow-up queue handling; that ownership choice is not settled by the current mocked tests.

options.title: Keep graceful agent-core stop
options.body: Land this dual-layer implementation after live proof confirms mixed-batch shutdown and the resulting terminal and queued-message behavior.

options.title: Use run-owner abort
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106297 if critical loop detection must produce an explicit aborted/error run outcome rather than graceful completion.

recommendation.title: Keep graceful agent-core stop
recommendation.body: Land this dual-layer implementation after live proof confirms mixed-batch shutdown and the resulting terminal and queued-message behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The release history connects this person most directly to the current critical tool-loop blocked-result behavior.
